finalText:
Migrated 12 files in `packages/` from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`: `cohort.js`, `returnService.js`, `shipment.js`, `refund.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`.

Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says it's overwritten wholesale on every vendor upgrade, so local edits would just get lost.

`cache.query` calls in several files are a separate cache module, not `db.query`. Left those untouched.

No `db.query` calls remain under `packages/`.
